scope: existing 240-clip carve (R3D holdout); 235 locally analyzable clips

temporal_errors_frozen_rule.note: errors are characterised, NOT used to adjust any threshold

failure_concentration.interpretation: failures cluster by source video; the largest cluster is the known hard source identified during fold-0 forensics, whose Fight clips have a median max-window score far below the carve-wide median

camera_motion_sensitivity.evidence: raw pixel speed separates classes better (AUC 0.855) than the scale-normalised form (0.806), and apparent person size itself separates classes (diagonal AUC 0.615). Neither observation isolates subject motion from camera motion.

experiment_required_but_NOT_run.what: global motion compensation (e.g. frame-to-frame homography or optical-flow background estimate) subtracted before computing per-track displacement, then re-characterise on the development carve
experiment_required_but_NOT_run.data_required: none beyond the existing carve; this is compute, not new data
experiment_required_but_NOT_run.why_not_run: outside this phase's scope; it would change the frozen spatial feature definition, which is locked by the closed experiment

computational_bottleneck.measured: YOLOv8s person detection dominates; 34.4 s per 150-frame clip on CPU
computational_bottleneck.temporal_branch: R3D-18 sliding window ~9.9 s per clip on CPU
computational_bottleneck.real_time: NOT achievable on this hardware; ~7x slower than real time

early_detection_behaviour.source: previously frozen temporal analysis, not recomputed here
early_detection_behaviour.note: censoring-aware first-alarm statistics were established on the primary split under the earlier frozen protocol and are NOT recomputed or re-opened here
